newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar touch weaker as NY corrects down.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar touch weaker as NY corrects down.

text.p: White sugar futures turned marginally lower on Friday but still held in the day's tight ranges as New York corrected lower, traders said.
August built on the gains racked up during Thursday's trading, shrugging off the more bearish sentiment seen in New York as July raws corrected lower.
But traders said while London volume was encouraging in the morning, the pace seemed more sluggish in the afternoon.
London whites were still expected to remain strong on grounds on the normal tightening of supply towards August expiry, they said, adding that August/October was well supported at around $6.00.
"I think people are fairly encouraged for the moment. They're a little excited towards the upside...London's been reacting very well," said one trader.
At 1525 GMT August was down 20 cents at $323.50 and October down 60 cents at $317.20. Volume was 1,209 lots, mostly outright but boosted by a sprinkling of crosses.
In Paris, trading was confined to just 151 lots of the August contract, up 20 cents at $323.00.
